name: Assemble Review Brief
summary: Assemble a review brief from the real diff: scope, risk notes, and test evidence a reviewer can check line by line.
description: Invoked as a slash command, collects the bounded diff, maps each changed area to its risk and its test evidence, and emits a structured review brief with explicit unverified areas. It prepares review; it never performs approval.
refuses: It does not approve, request changes, or merge; the brief informs a human reviewer.
It does not describe files it has not read or diff ranges it has not inspected.
It does not omit areas it could not verify; it lists them as unverified.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate the declared preconditions deterministically before the workflow may begin.

produces: a review brief mapping each changed area to its risk, evidence, and explicitly unverified claims

flags.name: scope
flags.description: Restrict the brief to a bounded set of paths or a named commit range.
